key_values.event_name: 2020 Cameron Peak and East Troublesome fires

criteria.name: final_json_and_label
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON and the label rapid_growth_burn_signal_pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right label in prose or a JSON object with missing keys.

criteria.name: acreage_pulse_arithmetic
criteria.description: Extracts 30,000 and 170,000 acres and computes the 140,000-acre increase.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right values with minor rounding or transcription errors, or 1 point for only one acreage anchor.

criteria.name: growth_rate_and_containment_checks
criteria.description: Computes the 5.67 multiplier, 7.37 pulse-to-ten-day ratio, and 85 percentage-point containment gap.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for two correct quantities, or 1 point for one correct quantity.

criteria.name: image_metric_calculations
criteria.description: Computes dNBR excess as 0.0409 and annual-change peak-to-mean ratio as 25.57.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one correct image-derived quantity or a correct threshold sign with rough rounding.

criteria.name: threshold_ledger_decision
criteria.description: Applies all five pass tests and explains why the label passes.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct conclusion with an incomplete threshold ledger.

criteria.name: concise_computed_interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to computed growth and burn-signal values without adding direct loss, health, or later-flow quantities.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a mostly numeric interpretation with one extra claim not established by the ledger.
